title: Master Yoda Uses the Force…
front_description: Count Dooku slashes off Anakin's arm, and is about to finish off the young Jedi, when a diminutive figure emerges from the thick smoke of the hangar. "Master Yoda," says Dooku with a smooth mix of surprise, respect and irony. "You have interfered with our plans for the last time." Dooku levitates some nearby machinery and hurls it at his former mentor. Instantly, Yoda uses his mastery of the Force to deflect this assault.
back_description: This bust of Yoda was created for background use in the Jedi archives.
